mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies and 59 degrees near the Verona Public Library. Please note the air quality index is currently at 51, and we have a full moon illuminating the night.

September is officially designated as both Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month in Verona. Mayor Diaz is calling on all of us to help support our neighbors through advocacy and community action.

There is plenty to do, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, we have the Verona Area Kids Triathlon at the high school and a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
Regarding the weekly report, on August 17, the police department successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM for all your custard needs.
